tabs.html:
PC POWER Black Knight Silent-98 Gaming Wired Keyboard – Quiet, Compact & Durable

Dominate every game in silence with the PC POWER Black Knight Silent-98 Gaming Wired Keyboard — engineered for stealth, precision, and long-lasting performance. This full-size keyboard features 98 silent keys with ultra-responsive feedback, designed to deliver quiet yet accurate keystrokes ideal for late-night gaming, office use, or shared spaces.

With a durable wired USB connection, anti-ghosting support, and a compact 98-key layout, the Black Knight ensures fast input without missed commands. Its sleek black design and ergonomic structure provide both style and comfort for extended gaming or typing sessions.

Whether you're a competitive gamer or a casual user, the Black Knight Silent-98 offers a smooth, distraction-free experience with high reliability.


Key Features:

  • Silent keys for a quiet typing and gaming experience
  • 98-key compact layout for space-saving functionality
  • Anti-ghosting technology for precise, lag-free input
  • Ergonomic design for long-term comfort
  • Wired USB connection – plug-and-play, no drivers needed
  • Compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux
